description: focus-kit: when a session starts or resumes, show the dev-kit and campaign-kit runs that wait on you; when a kit writes a run's resume.md, rebuild the runs page.

hooks.command: input=$(cat); case "$input" in *'/resume.md"'*) printf '%s' "$input" | python3 "${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/scripts/focus_tool.py" on-write;; esac; exit 0
